ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral field.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity (white) ellipsoidal regions occupying the central-medial zones of both lobes, transitioning into low-intensity (black) pigment at the trailing edges and distal tips; right lobe shows more extensive white saturation reaching the distal-most pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; calculated internal angle of approximately 50-60 degrees; ventral-most vertex obscured by splash-induced occlusion.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes varying between 3-8 pixels; distinct macro-concavity (notch) on the medial-trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Linear-to-slightly-convex sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips; trailing edge maintains a generally horizontal orientation relative to the water line.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparse distribution of dark, sub-10-pixel circular clusters localized within the white high-intensity regions, most prominent on the medial-interior section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular indentation/excision on the trailing edge of the left lobe, located approximately one-third of the distance from the median notch to the tip.
